propositions: Plan review LLM spend is dominated by token consumption (66,000 calls, 26.5 calls per review, 71% re-runs across 779 tickets).
Token-reduction program identified evidence-backed changes including reuse paths, pre-LLM short-circuits, cache efficiency, criterion gating, and instrumentation without weakening gate outcomes.
All 18 child changes (17 planned plus 1 regression fix) must land through Gerrit with LLM-Review and Verified approvals.
Plan-review coverage instrumentation must report input/output/cache token totals including Pass-1 metrics in coverage.metrics.
Gate-blocking criteria (T3, T10, T5c HIGH, G7) must use operator-approved thresholds and maintain previous blocking behavior.
Instrumentation, cache optimizations, and criteria_routing changes are chained with specific ordering to avoid conflicts and measure improvements.
